content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Michael Cervantes (E025) requests admin access to Source Code.

There are conflicting notes:
- Note 1: full_time Analyst, recommendation write (max write since admin only for owning role Engineer)
- Note 2: contractor, basic security training, recommendation read (contractors can read; write requires advanced training; never admin)

The second note says it corrects the earlier full_time record. So the security DB shows contractor with basic security training.

Access policy:
1. full_time: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

If contractor with basic security training: max is read. Requested admin exceeds max, so grant max = read.

The Security agent's note corrects the HR note. Which to trust? The notes say note 2 corrects earlier full_time record. So the employee is a contractor with basic security training. Maximum access = read.

So grant read.

I'll submit read with reasoning.
